name: After recital E
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the UN Climate Change Conference 2025 in Belém, Brazil (COP30)
part_text: Eb. whereas as of November 2024, 31 countries and more than 150 companies endorsed the Net Zero Nuclear Initiative, while recognising that nuclear energy generation is the second-largest single source of clean, low-carbon electricity in the world, and the largest source of clean, low-carbon electricity in OECD countries;
